content.short: Etherspot is an account abstraction SDK and infrastructure platform delivering frictionless Web3 user experiences on Mantle and beyond.
content.description: Etherspot is a multi-chain account abstraction and transaction batching infrastructure platform whose Prime SDK enables developers to build smart account wallets with gasless transactions, batch operations, and cross-chain execution. The TransactionKit provides a simplified interface for complex multi-step DeFi interactions in a single developer-friendly package. Supporting Mantle Network, Etherspot helps developers build more accessible and user-friendly dApps that abstract away blockchain complexity.
content.meta: Etherspot is an account abstraction SDK for building frictionless Web3 experiences on Mantle. Discover Etherspot on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
